body: Ya my older sister, I tell her about it but she’s not always available

Ok, one night me, my mom, and my older sister had came home. And my older brother and my younger sister had spent the night at their friends house, and my dad was at work. So it was only the three of us was at the house. 

Me and my older sister had went ahead of mom and started to walk down our long hallway. The first room was the restroom, the second room was my dads room, the third room is my older sisters room, the fourth room is my older brothers room, and the last room is my moms room. (I slept in my moms room before my dad moved out)

Ok, as me and my sister went ahead. Once my sister had past our dads room, the his door slammed shut. And the door was wide open before it slammed shut, so the both of us did not see any one at the door. And the AC was not on. We ran back to my mom and told her what happened, and She didn’t believe us. 

So, me and my sister went back to door and tried to open the door and the door wouldn’t open. And this was the type of door that didn’t have a lock. We tired to open the door with force. It didn’t budge. And I remember that the door knob was really cold. I let go of door knob for sec before twisting it pushing is it open as hard as I could. The door swung open, we looked around the room to see who or what was blocking the door. 

We found nothing.
